intro: Two pictures of the same room, side by side: swipe toward the one that feels more like home. A few cards are a single picture: swipe right if you love it.

cards.question: The kitchen and living room: Light & Coastal or Period & Playful?

image.alt: The living room toward the fireplace with the kitchen open beside it. Left, Light & Coastal: white Shaker cabinets, pale sea-glass walls, limewashed brick, light oak floors. Right, Period & Playful: green lower cabinets, cream glass-front uppers, natural red brick, a white mantel, a schoolhouse pendant.

yes.summary: Period & Playful feels more like home in the kitchen and living room.

no.summary: Light & Coastal feels more like home in the kitchen and living room.

cards.question: The downstairs bath: Period & Playful or Warm & Grounded?

image.alt: The downstairs bath from the door: a step-free glass shower ahead. Left, Period & Playful: square white tile with a thin green line, a schoolhouse ceiling light, a checkerboard floor. Right, Warm & Grounded: handmade cream tile, warm brass fittings, a lantern sconce, a dark stone vanity top.

yes.summary: Warm & Grounded feels more like home in the downstairs bath.

no.summary: Period & Playful feels more like home in the downstairs bath.

cards.question: Your bath upstairs: Warm & Grounded or Period & Playful?

image.alt: Your bath upstairs under the dormer: a walk-in glass shower and the vanity under the window. Left, Warm & Grounded: handmade cream tile, brass fittings and lantern sconces, a gray-green vanity with a dark top. Right, Period & Playful: square white tile, a soft green vanity, a black and white checkerboard floor.

yes.summary: Period & Playful feels more like home in your bath upstairs.

no.summary: Warm & Grounded feels more like home in your bath upstairs.

cards.question: A kitchen set up so the two of you can cook at the same time. Love it?

image.alt: The kitchen run seen from the living room, with counter space along one wall and the range at the far end

no.summary: One of you does most of the cooking, with company nearby.

cards.question: Here's the plan upstairs: your own suite with its bath, and a guest room with its own bath. Love it?

image.alt: Upstairs through your dressing room and laundry, past built-in closets, to your bedroom at the end

no.summary: Not this one: we'll come back with another way.

cards.question: When everyone comes home: about 6 sleep comfortably, up to 9 with the sofa, and your suite stays yours. Feel right?

image.alt: Where everyone sleeps when the whole family visits: the upstairs plan with your bedroom and the guest room, and the list: your bedroom 2, the guest room 3, the dormer window seat 1, a bunk nook in the slope 0 to 1, and the living room sleeper sofa 2

yes.summary: That is enough room for family visits.

no.summary: We need more beds when family visits.

cards.question: Into the kitchen: fully open like this (Love it), or a wide opening framed in period trim (Nope)?

image.alt: The living room with the kitchen fully open beside the fireplace, no wall between them

yes.summary: Fully open: the living room and kitchen read as one room.

no.summary: A wide cased opening with period trim: connected rooms.

cards.question: The tub upstairs: the original tub kept in the guest bath, or a soaking tub in your own bath?

image.alt: Your bath upstairs from its doorway. Left: a walk-in glass shower and a vanity under the dormer window, with the original tub kept in the guest bath. Right: a soaking tub under the dormer window beside the walk-in shower

yes.summary: A soaking tub under the dormer window in your bath, beside a walk-in shower; the guest bath gets a walk-in shower.

no.summary: The original 1941 tub, restored, stays in the guest bath; your bath gets a large walk-in shower.

cards.question: Kitchen cabinets: gray-green or warm white?

image.alt: The living room toward the fireplace with the kitchen open beside it, the same room both sides. Left, Gray-green: soft gray-green Shaker cabinets with brass pulls. Right, Warm white: warm white Shaker cabinets with the same brass pulls.

no.summary: A soft gray-green on the kitchen cabinets.

cards.question: The fireplace brick: limewashed brick or natural red brick?

image.alt: The living room into the kitchen with the chimney and its black insert, the same room both sides. Left, Limewashed brick: the same brick limewashed soft and pale. Right, Natural red brick: natural red brick, cleaned and repointed.

yes.summary: Natural red brick, cleaned and repointed.

cards.question: The lower bath walls: beadboard or tile?

image.alt: The downstairs bath from the door, the same room both sides. Left, Beadboard: painted beadboard on the lower walls under a white cap. Right, Tile: white 3x6 tile on the lower walls under the same cap.

no.summary: Painted beadboard on the lower walls.

cards.question: Faucets, lights and knobs: nickel or warm brass?

image.alt: The downstairs bath from the door, the same room both sides. Left, Nickel: the same fittings and sconce in nickel. Right, Warm brass: warm brass shower valve, head, grab bar, faucet and lantern sconce.

yes.summary: Warm brass (or nickel plumbing with brass lights and pulls).

cards.question: Hanging lights: clear ribbed glass or milk-glass schoolhouse?

image.alt: The living room into the kitchen with two hanging lights, the same room both sides. Left, Clear ribbed glass: the same two pendants with clear ribbed glass shades. Right, Milk-glass schoolhouse: two schoolhouse pendants with white milk-glass shades.
